pages.title: Prerequisites
pages.text: Requires $(l)Touhou Little Maid$(). Set the maid's task to $(l)Hand Made$(), then put the tool in her main hand.$(br2)She won't swap tools by herself — you have to hand her a different one.

pages.title: Nine behaviours (by priority)
pages.text: $(li)$(l)5$() Press Hammer$(li)$(l)6$() Fluid transfer (uses pointer-marked targets)$(li)$(l)7$() Infusion Gun (finds a nearby depot/basin when no target marked)$(li)$(l)8$() Stirring Staff$(li)$(l)9$() Hand Saw$(li)$(l)10$() Mortar$(li)$(l)11$() Crusher Mortar$(li)$(l)12$() Bellows$(li)$(l)13$() Pointer deploy

pages.title: Favorability bonuses
pages.text: Higher favour means faster, cheaper work:$(li)cooldown $(c)−7.5%$() / $(c)−15%$() / $(c)−22.5%$()$(li)$(c)5%$() / $(c)10%$() / $(c)15%$() chance to skip durability$(br)$(br)$(italic)#6 and #7 are exclusive: once you mark draw/fill targets with the pointer, #7 steps aside.
